input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual and of general application, set it at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and place indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have made the liability cap mutual and applicable to the Agreement as a whole, set at the greater of 12 months' compensation and USD 1,000,000, because as drafted only TrueLink is capped (and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11) while Client's liability, including under its broad indemnity, is unlimited. Indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP sit outside the cap, and Client's payment obligations are not limited; if helpful we can accept a straight mutual 12-month fee cap with those carve-outs.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE 12 MONTH PERIOD IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THE FOREGOING LIMITATION.
